notes: DISCOVERED during the housing-starts-2026-09-17 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06). The residential corridor tracks the October, November and December HMI editions (nahb-hmi-2026-10-19 and -12-16 as proposals, nahb-hmi-2026-11-17 as a researched canonical) and has nothing at all for September — the one edition inside the next eleven days. Two measured reasons it belongs, both from ledgers already on the shelf. First, the pairing is structural, not incidental: nahb-hmi-2026-11-17's own instrument found that 71 of 78 NAHB-published HMI release days (91.0%) are the trading day immediately before New Residential Construction, and 2026-09-16 -> 2026-09-17 is that pair for the August reference month. Second, and specific to the proposing print: 2026-09-16's close is the denominator of the 2026-09-17 overnight gap, and that session is the densest in the corridor — retail sales and import/export prices at 08:30, this HMI and MTIS at 10:00, the VIX expiration, and the FOMC decision plus press conference at 14:00/14:30. The proposing lane's Leg 3 measures what that stack does to the following morning and concludes the print's own gap is uninformative there; naming the HMI as a tracked entry is what lets a later session diff that reasoning instead of rebuilding it. Impact LOW and symbols [] are proposed on the same measured grounds the sibling HMI ledger already established rather than on a guess — that lane tested the sentiment channel directly across 78 HMI days and found ITB open-to-close 0.9559% vs 0.9627% baseline (p=0.96) with the paired sentiment-vs-data sign test at p=1.00 — and whoever researches this id should re-derive both rather than inherit them.
